forms_editor: Field allowlist supports text/email/textarea/select/checkbox with required/help/length/options, explicit consent wording/version and HTTPS privacy URL, success message and bounded retention days.
Form draft Save and form Publish are separate conditional-version operations; both remain independent from page Save/Publish.
Published page rendering reads first-party published definitions only; preview forms are inert. Public submissions are same-origin and bind the published page revision and published form revision.
Submissions are normalized against per-field allowlists, require affirmative privacy consent, are limited by a honeypot and HMAC-keyed client digest, and never store raw IP or honeypot value.
Admin inbox is site-scoped with bounded search/pagination and status workflow; deletion is admin-only and audited after a successful conditional mutation.
Expired records are hidden from the inbox and scheduled bounded cleanup (10x100 batches per daily run) resumes on later cron events.
Oversized streamed JSON bodies are cancelled and rejected even without Content-Length; invalid UTF-8 and malformed/unknown payloads fail closed.
